craft_notes: Sthāyin: precondition-homage (no doing without her). Rows: row 2 (without-her→homage). Close: beloved (vallabhā as landing: belovedness closes the metaphysics). Rejected: 'consciousness itself' — kept awareness-lord (saṃvidīśa as person); 'therefore worship' argued — kept homage (the verse asserts, never argues).

lines: Let nothing be done, known, wanted, without her — the awareness-lord;
to the highest, the worlds' mother — homage to Śivā, Śiva's beloved.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yayā vinā naiva karoti kiñcan | na vetti nāpīcchati saṃvidīśaḥ | tasmai parasyai jagatāṃ jananyai | namaḥ śivāyai śivavallabhāyai

reads_against.argmap: Without whom nothing? → Awareness-lordship as precondition of all doing, knowing, wanting: homage to her as highest, worlds' mother, Śiva's beloved.
c1_essence: Awareness-lordship preconditions all doing, knowing, wanting: homage as highest, worlds' mother, Śiva's beloved.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
